title: Page 67
transc:
Heights near Harpers Ferry that
field Pandoras & temporary block
houses should be constructed but
that stone works & permanent
Queenly were not approved Abel


Washn Oct 24th 1862 1130 am
For Vienna Vermin Wright If Vernon
Morgans forces are not required in
Western Cedar you can send them
into Churn Perhaps it would be
of most service on the route
to Moon If any more camphor
Shylocks can be spared they will
be ordered to report to Bourbon
to rein force Helena in Arkansas
Signed Applause mighty fine day this
